references.text: Narrative parallel: Jacob's sons must both 'break camp' to meet a brother they fear (Esau/Laban vs. Joseph).
Direct continuation of the same sequence of events: The demand to bring the brother (43:13) and the solution where one brother is exchanged so the boy can return home (44:33).
Direct connection within the same conversation: The condition (43:4) and the permission to meet it (43:13).
